description: Phishing farm disguised as official bank customer support. Victims defrauded of KYC details under threat of card block.
Organized gang operating fake social media profiles to blackmail citizens with altered video recordings.
Senior citizen coercively kept under 24-hour Skype 'digital arrest' by suspects impersonating CBI officers.
Telegram recruitment scam offering payments for liking videos, leading to heavy deposits in virtual accounts.
Fake QR code scam targeted at OLX sellers pretending to send payments but instead debiting balances.
Suspects pretending to be Mumbai Crime Branch threatened victim with customs clearance charges for illegal drugs.
Circulation of high-quality fake Rs. 500 notes intercepted at local wholesale fruit market.
Urgent SMS sent threatening power disconnection, leading to download of malicious control app (AnyDesk).
Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS) biometric cloning leading to unauthorized withdrawals.
Fake crypto investment task platforms scamming remote work applicants of initial deposits.
Fake TRAI officer alert threatening to disconnect all mobile numbers unless victim cooperated with customs.
Fake banknote scanner detected fake Rs. 200 and Rs. 500 currency batches with identical serial sequences.
Suspect masquerading as UPPCL billing desk extracted netbanking PINs via fake support call.
Fake government subsidy / KBC lottery portal stealing UPI PINs via credential harvest pages.
Impersonators of cyber cell demanding money to delete fake online explicit clips of the victim.
Fraudsters representing a fake digital marketing agency lured job seekers into mock rating scams.
Counterfeit INR 500 notes seized from a grocery supplier. Lacked security thread shift and paper watermark.
SIM swap fraud leading to takeover of bank-registered mobile numbers and subsequent funds draining.
Victim blackmailed with fabricated money laundering charges by Skype impostors posing as police officers.
Fake SMS blast targeting commercial shopkeepers with power cuts unless immediate payments were made.
Impersonation of army personnel buying home furniture online, tricking sellers into clicking 'receive' request codes.
Work-from-home data entry scam demanding security deposits for legal agreements before releasing earnings.
Victim kept on call for 6 hours under CBI threat of passport confiscation, losing savings to safe accounts.
Suspects caught depositing duplicate currency notes at high-volume cash deposit machine (CDM) kiosks.
Texting fraud using custom UPI dynamic codes requesting immediate medical emergency aid on behalf of friends.
